correctness.summary: Correctness and requirement fit is meaningfully weak based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: The implementation appears to rely on an unsafe or incorrect assumption.
issues.suggestion: Address the concrete requirement, edge-case, invariant, or regression risk before polishing structure.

cognitiveComplexity.summary: Cognitive complexity is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: State transitions or side effects are difficult to reason about.
issues.suggestion: Simplify the hardest control or data flow while preserving a cohesive implementation.

readability.summary: Readability and intent is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: The control or data flow is not immediately understandable.
issues.suggestion: Make intent explicit through clearer naming, flow, or responsibility boundaries.

modularity.summary: Modularity and cohesion is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: One module owns too many independently changing concerns.
issues.suggestion: Regroup responsibilities around cohesive domain behavior without creating gratuitous layers.

coupling.summary: Coupling and dependency quality is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: A global or implicit dependency makes behavior harder to predict.
issues.suggestion: Remove or invert the dependency that most strongly leaks details or makes change unsafe.

changeability.summary: Changeability and change amplification is meaningfully weak based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: A brittle dependency chain amplifies otherwise local changes.
issues.suggestion: Centralize the relevant knowledge or boundary so the next conceptual change has a small, predictable edit surface.

abstractionQuality.summary: Abstraction and API design is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: One abstraction combines concepts that should vary independently.
issues.suggestion: Deepen, remove, or reshape the abstraction that currently adds more surface than value.

duplication.summary: Duplication and reuse is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

maintainability.summary: Maintainability is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: Failures would be difficult to isolate and diagnose.
issues.suggestion: Reduce the highest recurring cost of understanding, changing, debugging, or testing this code.

testQuality.summary: Testability and test quality is meaningfully weak based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: Important changed behavior lacks meaningful regression coverage.
issues.suggestion: Add or improve the smallest behavior-focused test that protects the important risk without overspecifying implementation.

reliability.summary: Reliability and error handling is meaningfully weak based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: Timeout or retry behavior is missing, unsafe, or disproportionate.
issues.suggestion: Handle the most credible failure path deliberately, including cleanup and propagation where relevant.

security.summary: Security is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

consistency.summary: Consistency and conventions is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: Related parts of the change follow inconsistent conventions.
issues.suggestion: Align the change with the repository's established pattern unless a documented constraint justifies the difference.

documentation.summary: Documentation and explainability is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: A non-obvious decision or constraint lacks an explanation of why.
issues.suggestion: Document the non-obvious contract, constraint, configuration, or rationale at the narrowest useful location.

performance.summary: Performance and resource efficiency is acceptable but improvable based on the supplied change context.

issues.description: Meaningful computation or I/O is repeated unnecessarily.
issues.suggestion: Optimize only the evidenced hot path or waste, keeping the design proportionate.
